description: Fork of exp039 (rank-flow LUT, 48k → 1.6610). Replaces separate Q/K BitPermutationLUTs with a single fp32 MultiHeadLut (input=64, n_heads=6, n_outputs=64). Each head's 64-dim output is split into [32 q || 32 k] and both halves are passed through VectorToDominance(32) → ±1 dominance before SDPA. V and out_proj remain BitPermutationLUT. Sum-mode pos path stays unnormalized. n_steps=8000 quick check vs exp020 (lr=1e-3, β2=0.95, bit-LUT QK, 1.8292 final) at the matching 8k horizon.
